summary: Phase 9 MANDATORY PROBE GATE, dispatch 1 of 3 (hard cap). Wrote probes/theta_place_validation.lean (scratch, outside Cslib/) defining the candidate target-independent translation Theta(G,Gamma,root) := sigAt G Gamma hfin root AND bigAndL(orphanFacts G Gamma root), and place(ht,x,A) := boxIter (ht x) A, per the plan. Subjected it to all five adversarial gate cases. RESULT: cases A (disconnected conclusion), B (disconnected context / orphan-component), C (premise_escapes_graph shape, no x-in-G.X restriction), and E (Graph.trivial collapse / Phase 20 assembly) all PASS -- each is a sorry-free, axiom-clean positive derivation, no sorryAx per #print axioms. Case D (orE at depth >= 1) FAILS: built a concrete two-level graph (root r, depth-1 child c2, disconnected target y3) and machine-checked the generic orE core step (caseD_orE_core_from_bridge). It IS provable GIVEN the bridge lemma box(A-or-B) implies (box-A or box-B), but no route avoiding that bridge was found using the full cs5_deriv_* toolkit plus a plausible (Phase-12-scoped, not independently re-derived) Theta-injection hypothesis: stripping boxes via tBox yields a bare disjunction, but the branch hypotheses derived via injection are necessarily boxed (matching place's own box-indexing), and there is no hypothesis-level necessitation to bridge bare-to-boxed. This CONFIRMS (via an actual machine check of the specific inference shape, not merely an inherited assertion) the plan's own flagged primary residual risk: the flat depth-indexed place := box^d A genuinely needs the non-theorem that killed plan v4's fully-boxed flat shortcut, once the disjunction sits at depth >= 1. No semantic countermodel of the bridge lemma itself was built (out of scope for a shape-validation gate -- would need a Kripke-model construction). OVERALL GATE VERDICT: FAIL, on case D only. Per the plan's FAIL-handling instructions, the next Phase 9 dispatch (2 runs remain of the 3-run cap) should design a layered Theta_0 implies box(Theta_1 implies box(...)) alternative whose per-level antecedents carry the disjunction unboxed at the correct nesting level, then re-run ALL FIVE cases against it (a layered redesign changes both Theta and place, so the currently-passing cases must be re-confirmed, not assumed). Only if no candidate closes all five cases within the remaining budget does this route to Phase 23. Cslib/ was not touched by this dispatch (verified via git status --short Cslib/ at every commit boundary); a concurrent, unrelated agent's edit to Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/LoopChecking.lean was neither staged nor committed by this dispatch.

blockers.description: orE at depth >= 1: the flat depth-indexed place(x,A) := box^{d(x)} A requires the non-theorem box(A-or-B) implies (box-A or box-B) to close the orE core step generically; no alternative route was found using the available cs5_deriv_* toolkit plus a plausible Theta-injection hypothesis.
blockers.goal_state: Derivable CS5ModalAxiom ((Theta Gt2 [] Gt2_fin r).imp (place ht2 y3 C)) from hOr : Theta(Gamma) implies box(A-or-B), hA : Theta((c2:A)::Gamma) implies place(y3,C), hB : Theta((c2:B)::Gamma) implies place(y3,C) -- closes only given an extra bridge hypothesis box(A-or-B) implies (box-A or box-B); stripping via tBox to bare (A-or-B) leaves the branch hypotheses boxed (box-A implies place(y3,C)) with no route to unbox them without necessitation from an arbitrary hypothesis (unavailable) or the bridge itself.
blockers.what_was_tried: Direct closure via inject + curry + orE Hilbert axiom (works only given bridge); T-iteration-only alternative (strips box off the major premise via tBox, but branch hypotheses remain boxed by construction of the injection step, so the antecedents do not line up).
blockers.root_cause: place's flat box-iteration conflates all labels at a given depth; disjunction elimination fundamentally needs the box to distribute over the disjunction's TWO cases separately, which the K-axiom based system does not validate (box(A-or-B) does not imply box-A or box-B, standard modal-logic non-theorem, semantically false in general Kripke models with distinct accessible worlds satisfying different disjuncts).
blockers.what_is_needed: A layered Theta/place redesign (e.g. Theta_0 implies box(Theta_1 implies box(...))) whose per-level antecedents carry the raw, unboxed disjunction at the exact nesting level orE needs, rather than a flattened box^d-wrapped formula -- to be designed and validated (all five cases) in the next Phase 9 dispatch.

decisions_made: Theta(G,Gamma,root) := sigAt G Gamma hfin root AND bigAndL(orphanFacts G Gamma root), reusing sigAt verbatim per the plan; orphanFacts is the Gamma-facts at labels not reachable from root (Relation.ReflTransGen), confirmed necessary and sufficient for case B.

place(ht,x,A) := boxIter (ht x) A, with ht an explicit graded-rank witness function (mirroring IsDerivationForest's own Function.update construction pattern) rather than a fully general depth accessor -- appropriately scoped to Phase 9 shape validation, not Phase 10/11's general depth-accessor infrastructure.

Theta-injection for case D's concrete two-level graph was posited as an explicit named hypothesis rather than independently re-derived, since the landed sigAt_cons_self_imp (closest analogue) itself avoids computing an explicit Finset.toList for this reason -- confirmed this is genuine Phase-12-sized infrastructure, correctly out of Phase 9's scope.

No semantic countermodel of the box-or-distribution bridge lemma was built; the case D deliverable is the structural machine-checked dependency, not a fresh semantic refutation (judged sufficient per the plan's case-D pass criterion, which asks only that 'the finding is recorded').
